exposure: maternal comorbidities (anaemia, diabetes, malnutrition, thyroid disorders, hypertension, antepartum hemorrhage, infection)
cohort: The study included 200 mothers who delivered low birth weight babies (<2,500 g) in a rural medical college hospital in Central India.
finding: Maternal weight, parity, socioeconomic status, and comorbidities including anaemia, diabetes, malnutrition, and thyroid disorders were significantly associated with low birth weight.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with low birth weight.
